findings.title: IX cancellation still has no unsettled revocation edge after Effect reconciliation has already begun
findings.requirement: PLAN §8.4 and manifest §§15.2 and 15.5 require the IX revocation relation to accept SHADOW_PASSED|FROZEN|EVIDENCE_STALE at every reachable REQUESTED|QUIESCING protected X/N/UNSETTLED coordinate, with exact equality to the six IX06 revocation guards and no inferred edge.
evidence: Manifest row IC24-A can produce candidate EVIDENCE_STALE with rollout WIDENING_RECONCILING or PROMOTION_RECONCILING while the exact original Effect remains unsettled.
IX01 is authorized for every reachable nonterminal tuple and can then change work_cancel_state NONE->REQUESTED without changing that already-reconciling rollout or unsettled Effect.
Manifest §15.5 rejects ordinary candidate rows, including IC32-E, while cancellation is not NONE.

IX06-UR/UQ require the unsettled source rollout WIDENING_EFFECT|PROMOTING and synchronize it to WIDENING_RECONCILING|PROMOTION_RECONCILING; they do not accept a source already in either reconciliation rollout.
IX06-NR/NQ require protected N and IX06-XR/XQ require protected X, so none applies while the already-reconciling Effect is still unsettled.
Manifest has IC32-HU for this exact already-reconciling unsettled revocation ordering when cancellation is NONE, but no corresponding IX row for REQUESTED or QUIESCING.
adversarial_trace: Reach SHADOW_PASSED + WIDENING_EFFECT + an unsettled original Effect + rollback IDLE + cancellation NONE.
Commit IC24-A on a bound-digest change: candidate becomes EVIDENCE_STALE and rollout becomes WIDENING_RECONCILING while the original Effect identity remains unsettled.
Commit IX01 before Effect settlement: cancellation becomes REQUESTED and ordinary IC32-E is now forbidden.
Deliver an authenticated revocation before the Effect obtains protected X or N classification.
IX06-UR rejects because the rollout source is already WIDENING_RECONCILING; IX06-NR and IX06-XR reject because N/X is not yet available; no authored row records EVIDENCE_STALE->REVOKED.
The same missing owner exists at QUIESCING and for PROMOTION_RECONCILING. A second reachable ordering is IX01 then non-revocation IX06-UR/UQ, followed by revocation before settlement.
findings.impact: A valid revocation in a reachable cancellation tuple must be deferred without an authored revocation transition, dropped, or applied through an inferred edge. This contradicts the claimed exact and total UNSETTLED revocation partition and leaves the candidate disposition undefined until a later X/N receipt that may itself require bounded reconciliation.
findings.required_correction: Add exact REQUESTED and QUIESCING IX unsettled-reconciliation revocation rows, analogous to IC32-HU, for WIDENING_RECONCILING|PROMOTION_RECONCILING with candidate SHADOW_PASSED|FROZEN|EVIDENCE_STALE. They must atomically record REVOKED, preserve the exact Effect/reconciliation/rollback/cleanup identities, keep the existing fence, create no saga or cleanup, and remain pairwise exclusive with IX06 X/N and IC32 by classifier, cancellation state, and tuple-version CAS. Extend CancellationRevocationCoordinatesV1 equality and witnesses to revocation before versus after IX06-U and before versus after settlement.
